auth.welcomeSubtitle: Your vehicle's digital logbook, and help wherever you are
auth.phoneHint: We'll text you a verification code
auth.guestHint: Try the logbook first. Add your number or email any time and keep everything.
auth.emailSubtitle: Mobile is the main way in; email is an alternative.
auth.guestBannerTitle: You're using Habba as a guest
auth.guestBannerBody: Add your mobile number or email to keep your logbook on any device.
auth.guestUpgradeBody: Your logbook and everything you've recorded stays exactly as it is — we're only adding a way to sign in.

errors.invalidPhone: That mobile number isn't valid. It should start with 5 and be 9 digits.
errors.invalidOtp: That code is wrong or has expired. Check the message, or request a new code.
errors.otpExpired: That code has expired. Request a new one.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.network: Couldn't connect. Check your internet and try again.
errors.guestNeedsIdentity: Add a mobile number or email to save the account.
errors.invalidCode: That code is not right. Check the email, or ask for a new code.
errors.codeExpired: That code has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a moment, then ask for a new code.

auth.emailCodeSubtitle: We sent a code to {{email}}. Check your inbox, and your spam folder.
auth.nameOptionalHint: Optional — we use it to address you.

vehicle.addSubtitle: Three steps, and the plate is optional
vehicle.plateHint: Optional — you can add it later

errors.plateUnparseable: We couldn't read that plate. Use up to 3 letters and 4 digits, e.g. A B J 1234
errors.vinInvalid: A VIN is 17 characters and never contains I, O or Q.
errors.mileageImplausible: Check that reading — the number doesn't look right.
errors.saveFailed: We couldn't save this vehicle. Check your connection and try again.
errors.alreadyInLogbook: This car already has a Habba logbook. If it is yours now, ask the previous owner to transfer ownership to you in the app.
errors.conversionOffline: This step needs a connection to Habba's servers.

vehicle.mileageHint: Helps us predict when the next service is due
vehicle.lastOilHint: Approximate is fine — the reading or the date, whichever you remember.
vehicle.convertSubtitle: The car's details come from the inspection report. We only need the make and model.
vehicle.fromReportNote: Year, plate, VIN and odometer are carried over from the report exactly as the inspector recorded them.
vehicle.convertAction: Add this car to my logbook

logbook.title: Vehicle logbook
logbook.emptyBody: Every service, inspection and part gets recorded here. Over time this becomes the most valuable thing you own when you sell the car.
logbook.recordSubtitle: Add service that happened before Habba. It appears in the logbook as owner-entered.
logbook.recordNotVerifiedNotice: This entry shows as “owner-entered” because Habba did not carry out the work. Services Habba performs appear as verified.
logbook.reportShareHint: A PDF ready to share or print. It carries neither your name nor your number.

errors.futureDate: A service cannot be dated in the future.
errors.mileageTooLow: That reading is below the recorded {{current}} km. Check the number.
errors.reportChainBroken: The report could not be issued because this logbook failed verification. Contact support.
errors.reportFailed: The report could not be issued. Try again.
errors.reportShareUnavailable: The report was created, but this device could not open a share sheet.
errors.cost: That amount is not valid. Use digits, e.g. 350.00

logbook.recordDocumentedNotice: With a photo attached this entry becomes “owner-entered with evidence”, which is worth more at resale than an entry with nothing behind it. Full verification stays with work carried out through Habba.
logbook.mileageSubtitle: Mileage is what maintenance alerts are built on, and the first thing a buyer asks about.
logbook.mileageNewHint: The odometer never goes backwards. Enter the number showing now.
logbook.mileageEmptyBody: Record today's reading, and another later on, so Habba can estimate how much you drive and warn you before a service is due.
logbook.mileageSince: {{km}} km since the previous reading · about {{perDay}} km/day

detail.provenanceVerified: Habba carried out this service and documented it with a mileage reading and photos. This is the highest level.
detail.provenanceSelfDocumented: The owner entered this record and attached evidence. Habba did not carry out the work and does not vouch for its content.
detail.provenanceSelfReported: The owner entered this record with no attachment. Habba attests only that it has not been altered since.
detail.provenanceThirdParty: This record came from a third party.
detail.appendOnlyNote: Records are never edited or deleted once entered — that is what makes the logbook worth something at resale. To correct a mistake, add a new record explaining it.
detail.missingBody: The link may be old, or the record may belong to a different vehicle.

logbook.coverageBody: Every service Habba performs is added verified. The more verified the record, the more the car is worth when you sell it.

settings.title: Settings
settings.restartRequired: Close the app and open it again to apply the language and writing direction.
settings.noContact: No phone or email added yet
settings.signOutConfirmBody: Your vehicle data is saved, and the same phone or email brings you back to it.
settings.signOutGuestWarning: You're a guest — if you sign out now without adding a phone or email, you cannot get back to your logbook.
settings.languageHint: Changing the language changes the writing direction, which needs the app reopened.

errors.offline: You're offline. We'll save what you entered and send it when you reconnect.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.offlineBody: What you see may be out of date. It will refresh on its own once you're back online.

home.noVehicleBody: We need your vehicle's details to send an emergency request.
home.noRecent: You don't have any past orders yet.

booking.title: Book an appointment
booking.comingSoonBody: Scheduled and workshop bookings arrive in the next phase. For emergencies, use "Emergency request" from the home screen.
booking.serviceSubhead: Book a time that suits you — no rush.
booking.modeLockedWorkshop: This service needs a lift, so it is workshop-only.
booking.modeLockedMobile: This service is available as a mobile visit only.
booking.providerSubhead: Highest rated first. Price is for the service, before VAT.
booking.providerNone: No provider offers this service that way right now. Try the other option.
booking.slotSubhead: Available times over the next week.
booking.slotNone: This provider has no free times. Go back and pick another.
booking.problemLabel: Anything that helps the technician — optional
booking.errorSlotTaken: That time was taken a moment ago. Choose another.
booking.errorGeneric: We couldn't complete the booking. Please try again.
booking.noVehicle: Add your vehicle first so the service is recorded in its logbook.

emergency.title: Emergency request
emergency.locationHint: The technician will come to this location. You can edit the address.
emergency.locationDenied: We couldn't determine your location. Enter the address manually.
emergency.vehicleRequired: This service requires choosing a vehicle.

errors.noLocation: We couldn't determine your location yet.
errors.createFailed: The request could not be sent. Try again.

emergency.serviceSubhead: Pick one and we'll find your nearest technician right away.
emergency.triageTitle: Record 20 seconds — it helps the technician bring the right part
emergency.triageBody: Entirely optional. We've already started looking for a technician.
emergency.cameraAim: Point it at the problem or the sound
emergency.triagePermission: We need camera and microphone access to record the clip.
emergency.triageFailed: Recording failed. You can continue without video.
emergency.mapUnavailableWeb: The map is not part of the browser preview. The phone app shows it in full.
emergency.triageOrderPlaced: Your request is on its way ✓
emergency.triageOrderPlacedBody: We're finding you a technician now. The next step is entirely optional — you can skip it.

tracking.title: Track request
tracking.searchingBody: We usually find one within a minute.
tracking.quoteReadyBanner: A parts quote has arrived — review it to continue
tracking.confirmCompletionBody: Confirming closes the order and captures the held payment.
tracking.completedBody: This work was added to your vehicle's logbook automatically.

errors.cancelFailed: The request could not be cancelled.
errors.rateFailed: We couldn't send your rating. Try again.

tracking.searchingReassure: Nothing needed from you. Keep your phone handy and we'll tell you the moment we find someone.
tracking.avgMatchTime: Average match time in your area right now is {{minutes}} minutes
tracking.cancelFreeBeforeMatch: Cancelling before a match is free
tracking.priceFixedNote: The price is fixed. Any additional work reaches you as a quote you approve yourself before it starts.
tracking.waitingAtVehicle: Waiting for you at the vehicle
tracking.handoverCodePrompt: Give {{name}} this code before work starts
tracking.workingBody: They'll update you at each step. Nothing needed from you.
tracking.contactUnavailable: Calling the technician isn't available yet — we're setting up a relay number that protects both sides' privacy.
tracking.awaitingBody: Your booking is recorded and the time is held for you. The workshop still has to confirm it, and we'll tell you as soon as they do.

quote.title: Parts quote
quote.subtitle: Review each part before approving the work as complete.
quote.allApprovedHint: Once every part is approved, the work moves to completion confirmation.
quote.pendingHint: Not every part is approved yet.
quote.approveFailed: We couldn't record your approval for this part. Check your connection and try again.

earnings.title: Earnings
earnings.vatNote: Commission is taken on parts and labour only, never on the VAT. The VAT is still inside your net amount and remains your responsibility.
earnings.noPayoutsBody: Your first payout appears here after the settlement period closes. What you are owed is shown above in the meantime.

quoteBuild.title: Quote
quoteBuild.subtitle: Add parts and labour. The customer approves every line before the job can be handed back.
quoteBuild.vatNote: VAT is computed on the server at 15% on parts and labour; the total above includes it.
quoteBuild.noParts: No parts added. If this is labour only, enter the labour amount below.
quoteBuild.partNumberHint: Optional — but it is what documents the record at resale
quoteBuild.warrantyHint: Optional — recorded in the vehicle logbook
quoteBuild.approvalNote: The customer approves each line from their phone. The job cannot be handed back until they have approved them all — and re-pricing an approved line revokes that approval.

errors.price: That price isn't valid. Use digits, e.g. 320.00
errors.quantity: Quantity must be a whole number above zero.
errors.labour: That labour amount isn't valid. Use digits, e.g. 100.00
errors.saveFailed: The line couldn't be saved. Check your connection and try again.

inspection.subtitle: Rate every item, and add a note wherever something is wrong. The buyer reads this before paying.
inspection.subjectHint: A pre-purchase inspection runs against a car that is not registered with Habba, so the report carries its identity itself. Enter the plate or the VIN — at least one.
inspection.vinHint: 17 characters, never containing I, O or Q
inspection.needsSubject: Add a plate or a VIN — the report has to identify the car that was inspected.
inspection.scoreNote: The score and recommendation are computed on the server from the template's weights. You describe the car's condition; you do not grade it.

triage.title: Video from the customer
triage.why: Twenty seconds the customer recorded of the problem. Watch it before you set off — the sound is a large part of the diagnosis.
triage.unavailable: No video is available for this job.
triage.privacy: This video belongs to this job and cannot be shared. The link expires in minutes.

inspectionReport.title: Inspection report
inspectionReport.noFindings: Nothing was flagged on this car.
inspectionReport.scoreNote: The score is computed on the server from the item weights: brakes do not count the same as interior trim, and items that do not apply are excluded from the average rather than scored zero.
inspectionReport.convertBody: Add it to your account and this inspection becomes the first entry in its logbook — your ownership starts with a documented history instead of a blank page.
inspectionReport.convert: Add this car to my account
inspectionReport.convertedTitle: The car is in your logbook
inspectionReport.convertedBody: This inspection is the first entry in its logbook, and it travels with the car in its Habba Report when you sell.

provider.onlineHint: You're receiving nearby jobs. Your location is shared only while working.
provider.offlineHint: Not receiving jobs. Your location is not shared.
provider.locationStale: Your location couldn't be updated, so no jobs will reach you until it does. Check your connection and location permission.
provider.locationDenied: Location access is denied. Dispatch cannot see you and no jobs will reach you. Open Settings and allow location access.
provider.locationUnavailable: We couldn't get a fix just now — a basement or a tunnel will do that. We'll keep trying; until then no jobs will reach you.
provider.locationRejected: We have your location but couldn't send it to the server. Check your connection — no jobs will reach you until it arrives.
provider.addressAfterAccept: The address appears once you accept the job.
provider.awaitingCustomer: Waiting for the customer to approve the work.
provider.evidenceWhy: The odometer reading and before/after photos go into the vehicle's logbook, and the Habba report at resale depends on them.
provider.evidenceRequired: Required: odometer reading, one before photo, one after photo.
provider.evidenceBlocks: Complete the documentation before sending the work to the customer.
provider.mileageBelowRecorded: That's below the recorded {{km}} km. Check the number.
provider.mileageImplausible: That reading looks very high. Check the number of digits.
provider.captureHint: Point the camera at the car. The photo goes into the vehicle logbook and cannot be changed once saved.
provider.captureFailed: The photo couldn't be taken. Try again.
provider.cameraPermission: We need camera access to photograph the work before and after.
provider.uploadFailed: The photo couldn't be uploaded and was not saved. Check your connection and retake it.

upgrade.cardTitle: Work with us as a technician
upgrade.cardBody: Experienced with cars? Submit your details and start taking jobs once verified.
upgrade.cta: Work with us as a technician
upgrade.title: Register as a provider
upgrade.subtitle: Your account stays the same, and so do your vehicles and their logbooks. Technician mode is added once your details are verified.
upgrade.ibanHint: Starts with SA, 24 characters. Payouts go here.
upgrade.nafathNote: Nafath verification is required before approval and will be requested in a later step.
upgrade.submittedBody: We are reviewing your details and will be in touch, usually within two working days.
upgrade.submittedNote: Applying is not approval. Technician mode appears in your account only once approved.
upgrade.statusPending: Your application is waiting to be reviewed.
upgrade.statusApproved: You are approved. Technician mode is available in your account.
upgrade.statusRejected: Your application was not approved. You can apply again with correct details.
upgrade.statusSuspended: Your provider account is currently suspended. Please contact us.

errors.name: Enter your business name.
errors.nationalId: That National ID or Iqama number is not valid.
errors.iban: That IBAN is not valid. Check the digits.
errors.alreadyApplied: You already have an application in progress.
errors.submit: Could not send the application. Check your connection and try again.

provider.shiftSubtitleOnline: Your location is shared only while you're working, and stops the moment you go offline.
provider.noMyJobs: No jobs in progress. Nearby requests appear on the shift screen.

profile.title: My account
profile.noIdentity: No phone or email added yet
profile.modeBody: One account. Switch between customer and technician whenever you like.

orders.emptyBody: Your first request will appear here, and be written into your vehicle's logbook.

transfer.entryHint: Hand the car and its logbook to its new owner
transfer.warnTitle: The logbook goes with the car
transfer.warnBody: When the buyer accepts, the car and its entire logbook move to them. That is the point — a documented car sells for more — but a completed transfer cannot be undone.
transfer.keepsBody: Your orders and invoices stay in your account: what you paid, who did the work, and the tax record.
transfer.losesBody: The car leaves your list, its logbook stops being readable, and you can no longer issue a Habba report for it.
transfer.losesWarranty: The warranty goes with the car too: after acceptance you cannot claim a free re-service on work you paid for.
transfer.pdfOfferHint: After acceptance you cannot issue a report for this car. If you want a copy for your own records, take it now.
transfer.addressBody: Enter the buyer's mobile number or email. The transfer appears in their Habba account.
transfer.verifiedNotice: The number or email must be verified on the buyer's account. Address it to something they have not confirmed and nothing reaches them — with no explanation for either of you.
transfer.codeBody: Read this code to the buyer face to face, as the keys change hands. Habba does not send it.
transfer.codeOnce: Shown once only. If you lose it, cancel the transfer and create a new code.
transfer.pendingStillYours: The car stays yours until the buyer accepts and enters the code.
transfer.cancelConfirmBody: The code you gave the buyer stops working immediately. You can start a new transfer with a new code at any time.
transfer.expiredBody: Seven days passed without the buyer accepting, and the code no longer works. The car is still yours and nothing in its logbook changed.
transfer.exhaustedBody: The buyer entered the code wrongly five times, so it stopped working. Nothing changed for the car or its logbook, and the transfer is still to the same buyer.
transfer.exhaustedHint: The old code is cancelled and a new one is created for the same buyer, in one step.
transfer.acceptExhaustedBody: The code was tried five times without success, so it stopped working. Ask the seller to create a new one — the car is still waiting for you.
transfer.doneTitle: The car has been handed over
transfer.doneBody: {{vehicle}} has moved to its new owner, logbook and all.
transfer.incomingTitle: A car is waiting for you
transfer.incomingBannerBody: {{vehicle}} — take it, and its logbook with it.
transfer.weightNone: The logbook starts here — every service from now on is recorded in it.
transfer.welcomeBody: The digital logbook records every service, every inspection, every part. When you sell, the Habba report proves to the buyer that the car is documented — and a documented car sells for more.
transfer.acceptCodeHint: Six digits the seller reads to you at handover.
transfer.acceptedBody: The whole logbook came with it — {{count}} records. Every service from now on is added to it.

errors.addressRequired: Enter a mobile number or an email.
errors.phoneShape: A Saudi mobile number starts with 5 and has nine digits.
errors.emailShape: That email address is not valid.
errors.ownContact: That is your own contact. A transfer goes to the new owner.
errors.alreadyPending: A transfer is already pending for this car. Cancel it before starting another.
errors.claimOpen: A warranty claim is open on this car. Finish or cancel the re-service before transferring it.
errors.initiateFailed: Could not start the transfer. Try again.
errors.wrongCode: That code is not right. Check the digits with the seller.
errors.reissueFailed: Could not create a new code. Try again.
errors.gone: This transfer is no longer available — it expired or was cancelled.
errors.cancelFailed: Could not cancel the transfer. Try again.

transfer.warrantiesBody: A warranty follows the car. If ownership moves, it moves with it.

care.title: Coming up
care.subtitle: What your car needs soon — and which parts of that are certain.
care.empty: Nothing tracked yet. Add your last oil change and we will follow it from there.
care.nothingDue: Nothing due soon. We will tell you when something is.
care.estimateNote: Distance estimates come from your last odometer reading. Confirm it to sharpen them.

item.afterKm: Expected in about {{km}} km — confirm your odometer
item.unknown: We do not know when this was last done — tell us and we will track it

schedule.title: Workshop schedule
schedule.subtitle: The times customers can book. Anything not published here does not exist to them.
schedule.publishHint: Set your opening hours once, and they appear to customers as bookable times.
schedule.publishBody: Starting today. Hours that have already passed are not published — they cannot be booked.
schedule.capacityHint: How many cars the workshop takes at the same time.
schedule.publishedNone: Nothing new — these times are already published.
schedule.publishFailed: Could not publish. Check the hours and try again.
schedule.emptyBody: No customer can book your workshop until you publish your opening hours.
schedule.blockHint: Stops new bookings only. Appointments already taken stay exactly as they are.
schedule.unblockHint: Shows the time to customers again.
schedule.blockFailed: Could not update the appointment. Try again.
schedule.deleteBooked: Someone has booked this time, so it cannot be deleted. Stop bookings instead if you want to close it.
schedule.deleteFailed: Could not delete the appointment. Try again.

errors.hours: The day has to start before it ends, and the hours run 0 to 24.
errors.tooShort: The appointment is longer than the working day. Shorten it or extend the day.

schedule.bookingsBody: The customer has booked and is waiting for your answer. Confirming fixes the appointment; declining cancels it and returns the place to your calendar.
schedule.confirmFailed: Could not confirm the booking. Try again.
schedule.declineFailed: Could not decline the booking. Try again.
schedule.declineConfirmBody: The customer's order is cancelled and the place returns to your calendar. They have arranged their day around this time.
